headline: C# Development · Technical Support · Field Service
summary: C# developer with experience maintaining YAPI’s legacy application, building installation tools, and contributing React/TypeScript admin features. Led six technical-support agents while continuing hands-on development. Currently a Field Service Technician I at AGS, servicing gaming equipment across Southern California and parts of Arizona.

experience.summary: Service gaming equipment across Southern California and parts of Arizona, with parts inventory and on-call responsibilities.
points: Install, service, and maintain slot machines, progressive controllers, card shufflers, and table games.
Replace parts, maintain a service-parts inventory, and provide on-call coverage.
Travel throughout Southern California and parts of Arizona, maintaining working relationships with casino managers.

experience.progression: Joined as a Technical Support Specialist; promoted to Senior Specialist in October 2020 and Team Lead in April 2021. Final title: Onshore Support Manager. Software development was part of these roles.
experience.summary: Maintained the main legacy C# application, built installation utilities, contributed React/TypeScript admin features, and managed six support agents.
points: Maintained YAPI’s main legacy C# application, fixed bugs, and released patches; served as its only maintainer during part of the company’s React rebuild.
Built a C#/SQLite server-installation tool that reduced setup from approximately 2–3 hours to 45–60 minutes.
Fixed an Eaglesoft connection-string compatibility issue within one day. It affected approximately one-third of YAPI’s Eaglesoft customer base; the patch released the same week after QA approval.
Added remote database resets to the React/TypeScript admin panel, replacing customer calls and remote server sessions.
Managed six support agents and a team workload of hundreds of tickets weekly. Conducted reviews, one-on-ones, and training, and reported department progress to the CEO.
Owned technical-support documentation in Confluence and created training videos. Tested fixes in VM server environments before handing them to QA through Jira.
Handled contracting assignments for hardware and software troubleshooting.
Installed and migrated business and personal applications.
Installed pickups and wired custom guitar electronics to supplied schematics.
Soldered, inspected, and tested completed assemblies.
Installed and repaired commercial reverse osmosis equipment, produce misters, and meat foggers in supermarkets.
Diagnosed mechanical and electrical issues and performed preventive maintenance while working independently on service routes.

experience.progression: Promoted into a reporting-migration project in two phases totaling approximately one year of analyst work within this tenure.
points: Rewrote SQL reports for a migration from Crystal Reports to IBM Cognos.
Operated forklifts and cherry pickers, handled shipping and receiving, and sorted inventory on automated lines.
